text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: opening connective with resumptive force, linking the prior sign passage to a new biological evidence block
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the discourse forward from the preceding signs while opening a fresh creation claim. Its force is continuity with renewal: the biological scene is connected to the sign-sequence, but the clause is not grammatically dependent on the previous ayah. The shift from direct address to third-person declaration lets the named divine agent become the focus of the new evidence block.

topics.headline: connected restart into biological signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as a connected new evidence block, not as an isolated biological observation.
topics.reason: The local conjunction begins an independent creation clause while the boundary rows tie it to the preceding sign sequence.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name placed before the perfect verb as explicit creator-agent
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name field; local grammar selects the uniquely named divine agent while derivational pressure remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is named before the creating verb, so the origin statement is personal and agentive rather than anonymous. The proper-name form keeps the creator maximally definite, while derivational discussions around worship and bewildered turning remain only lexical pressure. Within the same surah, this named creator also reverses the water field from deceptive appearance (24:39) to generative source here. This first naming begins the ayah’s threefold divine-name structure: past creation, ongoing creation, and final power.

topics.headline: proper name foregrounds agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the creator named before the act, so creation is not framed as an impersonal process.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the nominative subject of the perfect creation verb.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses relational pressure around the divine name while the local word remains a proper name.
topics.reason: The derivational discussion is meaningful but cannot replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: same-surah water reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that water in this surah moves from deceptive appearance (24:39) to generative source here.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete same-surah contrast and the local clause contains the generative water source.

topics.headline: first beat of triple divine naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the first divine naming as the opening beat in the ayah’s past-creation, ongoing-creation, and power sequence.
topics.reason: The divine name appears at words 2, 27, and 31 with distinct clause roles.

words.gloss_range: active perfect Form I creation verb governing the universal creature object and a water-source complement
words.root_gloss_range: creation root spanning origination, proportioning, constitution, and fabrication; local Form I active perfect selects real measured origination
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) states completed origination with an explicit subject, object, and source: every moving creature is created, and water is the origin-complement. The perfect form contrasts with the later imperfect of the same root, so the ayah moves from established origin to continuing creative possibility. Root-family pressure around measured making survives, while fabrication and intensive shaping branches are locally narrowed away by the active Form I creation frame. The accepted creator-attribute reading and the related water-origin wording (21:30) sharpen the canonical form as an event-report of direct creation.

topics.headline: created object distinguished from source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the grammar separates what is created from what it is created from.
topics.reason: The verb is active perfect with the divine subject, a universal object phrase, and a following source phrase.

topics.headline: completed creation reopened later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that past creation at the opening is later answered by ongoing creation.
topics.reason: The same creation root appears first as perfect and later as imperfect.

topics.headline: measured making without fabrication overread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses creation as embodied constitution and measured origination, while false-fabrication branches stay outside the local sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports constitution and fabrication contrasts, but local Form I active creation with a concrete object selects real origination.

topics.headline: variant and aquatic-origin parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the canonical event-report differs from an accepted creator-attribute reading and from related water-origin wording (21:30).
topics.reason: The variant is valid contrast, and the intertext rows give concrete references without changing the canonical local parse.

words.gloss_range: accusative totality noun in construct with a singular indefinite creature noun, making the object distributively universal
words.root_gloss_range: totality and completion field; local use selects exhaustive distribution over the creature class
words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) places totality before the creature noun, so the later movement categories begin inside an already comprehensive object. Its singular construct with an indefinite singular makes the scope distributive: every individual moving creature is included, not just a mass or sample. The accepted genitive contrast would shift this totality from the finite verb's object into a creator-attribute construction. The later closing totality widens the frame from every creature to every thing.

topics.headline: every creature one by one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taxonomy subdivides an exhaustive creature claim rather than building totality from the examples.
topics.reason: The word is the accusative object head in construct with an indefinite singular creature noun.

topics.headline: accepted genitive contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that a variant case reading would shift the phrase from event-object to creator-attribute.
topics.reason: The row is useful as variant contrast but the canonical local parse is accusative object.

topics.headline: creature totality expands to thing totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a scope ring that opens with every creature and closes with every thing.
topics.reason: The same totality root frames the biological object and the final power domain.

words.gloss_range: indefinite feminine singular creature noun under totality; locally the class of moving creatures that the taxonomy will subdivide
words.root_gloss_range: creature-motion field with persistence pressure; local noun selects locomoting creaturehood, not every living entity in abstraction
words.prose: {{ar:دَآبَّةٍۢ}} ({{tr:dābbatin}}) names the created class as moving creaturehood. The singular indefinite works under totality, while later plural partitive pronouns turn the distributed individuals into a class that can be subdivided. Lexically, the word narrows life to creatures visible through locomotion; persistence and provision associations remain useful pressure, but the local taxonomy is organized by movement. The field can include the human observer through the biped category, and elsewhere the same creature term is tied to provision and restraint (11:6; 35:45).

topics.headline: singular generic for all moving creatures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the ayah moves immediately into walking categories: the object noun already selects locomoting creaturehood.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite singular under the totality noun, and the following taxonomy classifies by movement.

topics.headline: motion with persistence pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses creature identity as repeated self-motion, while the local sense stays anchored in moving-creature classification.
topics.reason: The persistence field supplies pressure, but the taxonomy makes locomotion the governing local axis.

topics.headline: provision field and observer inclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moving-creature field can include the human observer and is elsewhere tied to provision and restraint (11:6; 35:45).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references and the local biped category allows the observer to be included in the viewed class.

words.gloss_range: source preposition governing water after the universal object; origin and material specification are foregrounded
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) marks water as the source from which creatures are created, not merely the place where they live or an instrument used upon them. Its position after the full object phrase makes the origin claim apply to every moving creature. Source is primary, while partitive and specifying possibilities remain nearby only as nuance around material origin. Coming after the lesson-frame of 24:44, the preposition helps carry the sign sequence into a concrete origin claim about living bodies.

topics.headline: water as constitutive source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that water is presented as constitutive origin for the created class, not as environment or tool.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the preposition before the governed water noun as a source complement of creation.

topics.headline: source with partitive/specifying nuance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the source sense primary while hearing that the preposition can also specify the creaturely material.
topics.reason: Reference evidence supports source-origin locally; broader values are retained as nuance, not replacement.

topics.headline: sign lesson crosses into water origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous sign-lesson continue into a concrete origin claim about living bodies.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the prior lesson frame to the water-source statement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite water/source-fluid noun governed by source preposition; broad origin substance rather than a named body of water
words.root_gloss_range: water/fluid field with disputed derivational pressure; local sense is origin water or vital fluid for moving creatures
words.prose: {{ar:مَّآءٍۢ}} ({{tr:māʾin}}) appears indefinite, so the source is not a named or bounded body of water. The word can carry a wider origin-fluid range, including vital fluid, abundance pressure, and root-form instability, while the local creation frame keeps it as the material source of moving creatures. Same-surah and cross-surah water rows sharpen the payoff: water here is generative substance, not deceptive appearance (24:39), and it belongs with related water-origin statements (21:30; 25:54).

topics.headline: nonspecific generative water
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is generative water or vital fluid in general, not a specified body of water.
topics.reason: The indefinite genitive noun is governed by the source preposition and supports a nonspecific origin-fluid reading.

topics.headline: water-root and abundance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a broad fluid-family field while the local grammar keeps source-water as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root and form rows supply fluid pressure, but the local phrase selects material origin.

topics.headline: generative water contrasted and paralleled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the water-origin formula and its same-surah reversal from deceptive water (24:39) to generative water here, alongside related origin statements (21:30; 25:54).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete references and the local clause supplies the generative water source.

words.gloss_range: detailing/resultative particle that turns the universal origin claim into a taxonomy
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from origin claim to classification. It does not merely continue the sentence; it branches the universal statement into examples of how creatures move. Because it launches the repeated partition frame, the taxonomy feels like consequence and detail at once.

topics.headline: detail particle launches classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact pivot where universal creation from water becomes a visible locomotion taxonomy.
topics.reason: The particle begins the first partition clause after the origin statement and before the repeated subset frame.

words.gloss_range: first partitive phrase with plural pronoun, partitioning the already universal creature class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُم}} ({{tr:minhum}}) begins the anaphoric partition frame: from among them, one class moves on its belly. The pronoun reaches back to the universal moving-creature class, while its plural form lets singular generic creaturehood become a subdivided population. The rational-style pronoun gives even nonhuman creatures a grammar of classified agents.

topics.headline: first subset from the creature class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list as subsets inside the earlier universal class, not as a new species inventory.
topics.reason: The preposition plus pronoun resumes the creature antecedent and begins the first partition clause.

topics.headline: agentive plural pronoun for creatures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that animals are handled with a plural pronoun that supports agentive classification.
topics.reason: The pronoun refers to the creature class and is repeated across the taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: first relative pronoun introducing a singular acting subject within the creature subset
words.prose: {{ar:مَّن}} ({{tr:man}}) turns the first subset into an acting subject: whoever among them walks on its belly. The rational relative is marked for animal classification, but the repeated grammar gives each class a subject position rather than reducing it to a body type. It also sets up the repeated relative-clause skeleton of the taxonomy.

topics.headline: rational relative makes a creature type act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each category is stated as an acting subject, not just as anatomy.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a relative pronoun governing the following singular verb.

topics.headline: first beat of repeated relative clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first form of a repeated classifying skeleton that will organize all three visible categories.
topics.reason: The same relative-plus-verb pattern recurs in the second and third taxonomy clauses.

words.gloss_range: first singular imperfect walking verb; habitual locomotion stretched to belly movement
words.root_gloss_range: walking/self-motion field; local use selects generic locomotion broad enough to include crawling-like movement
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْشِى}} ({{tr:yamshī}}) supplies the taxonomy’s invariant action. In the first clause, walking is stretched to belly-based locomotion, so the verb means habitual self-motion rather than only upright human walking. Its repetition later unifies unlike bodies under one movement axis and helps make the three examples representative rather than exhaustive.

topics.headline: singular imperfect for habitual movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the creature type is characterized by ongoing habitual locomotion, not by a one-time act.
topics.reason: The imperfect singular verb agrees with the relative pronoun and classifies by repeated motion.

topics.headline: walking broadened to belly motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the walking verb is locally broadened to cover crawling-like self-motion while staying Form I locomotion.
topics.reason: The belly phrase forces the walking field wider than prototypical biped walking, but the form remains simple self-motion.

topics.headline: repeated locomotion unifies categories
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one verb refrain holding the unlike body-forms together and preparing for the open creation coda.
topics.reason: The same verb appears at words 11, 17, and 23, and the coda opens beyond the examples.

words.gloss_range: first surface-contact preposition, making the belly the support surface for locomotion
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) fixes the comparison axis as what the creature moves upon. Here the preposition makes the belly itself a support surface, an unusual contact point that will be compared with legs, four supports, and finally the domain of divine power. The first physical use therefore begins the ayah’s movement from concrete support to metaphysical scope.

topics.headline: surface contact defines the first class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the belly is treated as a locomotion surface, not just as an anatomical noun.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as spatial contact governing the belly noun.

topics.headline: first beat of the preposition arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a repeated preposition that will move from creature supports to divine power over all things.
topics.reason: The same preposition recurs in the three locomotion phrases and the final power clause.

words.gloss_range: possessed singular belly noun, the individualized underside surface of the first creature category
words.root_gloss_range: belly/inner-hidden field; local sense is anatomical underside while hiddenness pressure remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:بَطْنِهِۦ}} ({{tr:baṭnihi}}) individualizes the first category: the creature moves on its own belly. The singular possessed form keeps the locomotion concrete and body-specific. The root’s inner or hidden underside pressure adds texture to the image, but the local function is anatomical support surface; wider hiddenness echoes, including contrast with divine inwardness language (57:3), remain only a controlled resonance.

topics.headline: own belly as support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first locomotion class localized to each creature’s own underside.
topics.reason: QAC marks a genitive body-part noun with a singular possessive suffix governed by the surface preposition.

topics.headline: belly with hidden underside resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses underside and inwardness imagery while the local noun remains a concrete belly.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports hidden or inner pressure, but the grammar selects an anatomical support.

words.gloss_range: second coordinator joining the next locomotion class on equal footing with the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the second class without ranking it above or deriving it from the first. The connector keeps the taxonomy balanced: belly movement, two-legged movement, and four-support movement are coordinated examples inside one created class. Its force is equality and continuation, not causal sequence.

topics.headline: second class coordinated without ranking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second class is added as a peer category, not as an evolutionary or causal step.
topics.reason: QAC marks a coordinator joining the second partition clause to the first.

topics.headline: connector in three-part taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two connectors hold the three visible classes in one coordinated taxonomy.
topics.reason: The connector pattern joins the second and third categories after the first.

words.gloss_range: second partitive phrase repeating the same creature antecedent for the middle taxonomy slot
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُم}} ({{tr:minhum}}) resumes the same created creature class for the middle category. The repetition prevents the two-legged group from becoming a separate topic; it is another subset from the same universal field. As the central repetition, it keeps the taxonomy compact and anaphoric.

topics.headline: same source class in middle slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the biped group remains inside the same universal creature class.
topics.reason: The pronoun repeats the same antecedent and introduces the middle partition clause.

words.gloss_range: second relative pronoun, preserving the singular class-predicate grammar for bipeds
words.prose: {{ar:مَّن}} ({{tr:man}}) keeps the middle category in the same acting-subject frame as the first. Even where the movement is prototypical walking, the grammar remains generic and distributive: whoever among them walks on two legs. The middle occurrence also makes the 0-2-4 support progression visible.

topics.headline: generic biped subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the biped class is still a generic acting subject, not a human-only label.
topics.reason: QAC marks the same relative-pronoun grammar as in the first class.

topics.headline: middle beat in relative chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track this word as the middle beat of the repeated relative frame and support-count progression.
topics.reason: The relative frame repeats across the three taxonomy clauses and this occurrence sits before the two-leg phrase.

words.gloss_range: second singular imperfect walking verb, now in the prototypical biped slot but still distributive over a class
words.root_gloss_range: walking/self-motion field; local middle use is prototypical biped walking within the broader locomotion refrain
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْشِى}} ({{tr:yamshī}}) is the middle occurrence of the locomotion refrain. Here the verb lands in its prototypical two-legged use, but the singular imperfect still distributes over a class. Because the same verb covered belly motion and will cover quadrupedal motion, this middle use is one point on a wider movement axis rather than the definition of walking for the whole ayah.

topics.headline: prototypical walking in middle slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary biped walking is included without becoming the taxonomy’s norm.
topics.reason: The imperfect singular verb agrees with the relative pronoun and precedes the dual-leg phrase.

topics.headline: second beat of locomotion refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same Form I self-motion verb holding the middle class on the same axis as the others.
topics.reason: The verb repeats the same form and function across the taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: second surface-contact preposition governing the dual-leg support phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) repeats the same support relation before the exact dual. The preposition keeps the comparison axis stable: what matters is the surface or supports upon which movement occurs. The second occurrence therefore converts biped legs into the same structural slot as belly and four supports.

topics.headline: preposition frames two legs as supports
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that two legs are presented as contact supports within the same locomotion frame.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as governing the dual leg noun.

topics.headline: second beat of support chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks this as the second physical occurrence in the repeated support-chain.
topics.reason: The preposition repeats before the exact support phrase.

words.gloss_range: dual genitive leg noun, encoding the biped category by exact paired supports
words.root_gloss_range: leg/man/footedness field; local sense is two legs, while human-male associations are subordinated to creature taxonomy
words.prose: {{ar:رِجْلَيْنِ}} ({{tr:rijlayni}}) makes the middle category morphological: the dual ending itself encodes two supports. The word mediates between the singular belly and the bare cardinal four. Root-family associations with leg, walking, and man remain relevant as pressure, but the indefinite dual prevents the line from narrowing into a human-only reading.

topics.headline: dual form encodes two legs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the support count built into the noun’s dual morphology.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as dual genitive governed by the surface preposition.

topics.headline: leg field without human-only overread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the leg/walking/man field while the local phrase remains a general creature support count.
topics.reason: The lexical field is real, but the indefinite dual within creature taxonomy blocks a human-only restriction.

topics.headline: dual between belly and four
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle category as a morphological bridge between singular anatomy and cardinal number.
topics.reason: The dual form sits between the possessed singular belly and the later bare number.

words.gloss_range: final coordinator adding the third explicit class before the open creation coda
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the four-support class as another coordinated example, but it also stands just before the coda that reopens the list. The connector therefore gives the taxonomy a third visible member without making it final. The ayah can complete the pattern and still exceed it.

topics.headline: third class added before open coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the third class is coordinated as an example just before the ayah opens beyond the list.
topics.reason: QAC marks a coordinator before the third partition clause, and the following creation coda prevents closure.

topics.headline: connector sets up non-final ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a final visible list item that is immediately made non-final by the creative coda.
topics.reason: The connector precedes the third class and the coda follows right after it.

words.gloss_range: third partitive phrase returning quadrupeds to the same universal creature class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُم}} ({{tr:minhum}}) repeats the partition marker for the third time. The four-support class is still from among the same created creatures, not a separate domain. Because the coda follows, this third subset completes the visible anaphora while leaving the taxonomy illustrative rather than exhaustive.

topics.headline: third subset inside same class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the quadruped group as the third subset from the same universal creature field.
topics.reason: The pronoun repeats the same antecedent in the third partition clause.

topics.headline: third subset before open coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the completed threefold anaphora does not exhaust what God creates.
topics.reason: The following open creation clause limits any closed-list reading.

words.gloss_range: third relative pronoun, applying the same rational-style acting-subject grammar to quadrupeds
words.prose: {{ar:مَّن}} ({{tr:man}}) is most marked here because it introduces the four-support creature class with the same acting-subject grammar used for the previous groups. The relative pronoun keeps quadrupeds inside a rational-style classifying syntax and completes the repeated subject frame before the list opens outward.

topics.headline: rational-style relative for quadrupeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the quadruped class is phrased as an acting subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks the same relative pronoun introducing the third singular predicate.

topics.headline: final beat of repeated relative chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the third occurrence complete the repeated classifying skeleton.
topics.reason: The relative-plus-verb skeleton appears in all three visible classes.

words.gloss_range: third singular imperfect walking verb, extending the same self-motion verb to quadrupeds before the open coda
words.root_gloss_range: walking/self-motion field; local use confirms generic locomotion broad enough for quadrupedal movement
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْشِى}} ({{tr:yamshī}}) completes the triple locomotion refrain. In the third clause, the same walking verb covers quadrupedal movement, confirming that the ayah’s axis is generic self-motion rather than one anatomical style. Its position just before the open creation coda lets the refrain close the visible examples while admitting more forms beyond them.

topics.headline: walking extended to quadrupeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the walking verb stretched to four-support movement while staying a simple self-motion verb.
topics.reason: The four-support phrase requires a broad locomotion sense rather than only biped walking.

topics.headline: third refrain opens into coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated locomotion verb close the examples and hand off to the open creation clause.
topics.reason: The verb is the third repeated occurrence and is followed by the creation coda.

words.gloss_range: third surface-contact preposition governing a bare cardinal, with the counted support noun recoverable by ellipsis
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) now governs a bare number rather than an expressed body-part noun. That makes the support phrase more abstract: the listener supplies the supports from the locomotion pattern. The same preposition still marks contact or support, but the chain is moving from concrete anatomy toward count and then toward metaphysical scope.

topics.headline: preposition lets four act as support phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a bare number can stand in the support slot because the repeated preposition and prior clauses make the ellipsis recoverable.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition before a cardinal number, and the locomotion frame supplies the omitted counted noun.

topics.headline: third step toward abstraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the preposition chain becoming less anatomical before it shifts to divine power.
topics.reason: The third occurrence governs a number rather than belly or legs.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cardinal four with an elided counted support noun; canonical visible list halts at four while variants make surplus explicit
words.root_gloss_range: four/stability/dwelling field; local sense is cardinal support count, with stability pressure and beyond-four variant contrast
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْبَعٍۢ}} ({{tr:arbaʿin}}) gives the third category as a number, not as a named body part. The elided counted noun keeps four supports open enough for creature taxonomy, and the 0-2-4 progression becomes visible. The four-root's stability and dwelling pressure fits the steadiness of four supports, while same-surah four-count language can move from legal precision (24:4) to zoological taxonomy here. Variant rows that add more-than-four language sharpen the canonical effect: four is the visible halt in this reading, while the following coda already opens beyond the counted examples.

topics.headline: bare four as support count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the third category is classified by support count rather than by a specific limb noun.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite genitive cardinal governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: four with stability pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the stability of four supports while the local sense remains a cardinal count.
topics.reason: The root field can evoke stability and dwelling, but the local word functions as a number.

topics.headline: variant makes surplus explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that accepted variant material can make beyond-four categories explicit, while the canonical wording relies on the coda to open beyond four.
topics.reason: The variant rows are valid contrast but do not replace the canonical cardinal in the local parse.

topics.headline: 0-2-4 visible progression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the taxonomy as an ascending support-count pattern that stops visibly at four before reopening.
topics.reason: The three clauses move from belly support to two legs to four supports.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect creation verb reopening the earlier completed creation claim as ongoing creative possibility
words.root_gloss_range: creation root field; local imperfect Form I selects active ongoing creation, not a static noun or passive process
words.prose: {{ar:يَخْلُقُ}} ({{tr:yakhluqu}}) returns to the creation root after the taxonomy. The imperfect form reopens the completed origin statement: God creates whatever He wills, so the three visible classes cannot be a closed inventory. The phrase functions as a creative-sovereignty coda, with active creation aligned to active will.

topics.headline: ongoing creation after completed origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves from completed origin to continuing creative possibility.
topics.reason: The same root returns as an imperfect verb after the taxonomy.

topics.headline: creates whatever He wills
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda prevent a closed taxonomy by making creation unrestricted under divine will.
topics.reason: The verb governs the following open relative object clause.

topics.headline: verbal active creation aligned to will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears creation as active and ongoing rather than a static attribute.
topics.reason: QAC marks active imperfect Form I, and the following will verb is also finite and active.

words.gloss_range: postverbal nominative proper divine name, explicitly renaming the creator in the ongoing creation coda
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name field; local function is the same named agent, now after the imperfect verb
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is repeated where a pronoun could have sufficed, so the ongoing creation coda is explicitly tied to the same named agent as the opening. Its postverbal position contrasts with the fronted first naming, but the referent is unchanged. This is the second beat in the ayah’s triple divine-name structure.

topics.headline: named subject retained after verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ongoing creation coda renames the divine agent instead of relying on an implicit subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the nominative subject of the imperfect creation verb.

topics.headline: second beat of triple naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks this as the second divine naming, anchoring ongoing creation between past creation and final power.
topics.reason: The proper name appears in three clause roles across the ayah.

words.gloss_range: unrestricted relative object pronoun, opening the creation coda beyond the visible taxonomy
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns the object of ongoing creation into an open whatever. After the three locomotion classes, this relative pronoun breaks the illusion that the list has closed. It also shifts from rational-style creature categories to unrestricted created object-space.

topics.headline: whatever opens the taxonomy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coda opens beyond the three named locomotion categories.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the object relative pronoun of the creation verb.

topics.headline: open object after the list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that openness answers the list precisely because it comes after the three examples.
topics.reason: The relative object is completed by the will verb and placed immediately after the taxonomy.

words.gloss_range: imperfect will verb with implicit divine subject, selecting what enters the open creation object-space
words.root_gloss_range: will/thing root field; local sense is active determining will, with a root echo to the closing thing noun
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) completes the open object clause with active divine willing, and its implicit subject routes back to the immediately named creator. Its imperfect form matches the imperfect creation verb, so ongoing creation and ongoing will move together. The same root later appears in the thing noun, making will and thingness answer each other before the final capacity seal. The create-what-He-wills formula also recurs as unrestricted creative sovereignty (28:68; 30:54), so it licenses forms beyond the visible taxonomy.

topics.headline: imperfect will paired with imperfect creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine willing is active and ongoing alongside ongoing creation.
topics.reason: QAC marks a finite imperfect verb in the same coda as the imperfect creation verb.

topics.headline: will routed to named creator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the will clause as dependent on the immediately named creator, not as abstract wishing.
topics.reason: The 3ms verb has an implicit subject resolved to the divine subject of the creation coda.

topics.headline: will answers thingness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a root loop where willing and the thing willed into being answer each other in the closing clauses.
topics.reason: The will verb and thing noun share the same root field within the ayah.

topics.headline: fixed creative-sovereignty phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the create-what-He-wills formula as licensing unlisted forms and leading into the power claim (28:68; 30:54).
topics.reason: The phrase recurs with creation and will roots, and locally it follows the three examples.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle governing the final divine-name subject and the whole power predication
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the final power clause into asserted confirmation. It governs the divine name and scopes over the domain phrase and predicate, so the close is not a loose reflection after the taxonomy. The emphatic seal guarantees both the past creation claim and the open creation coda.

topics.headline: emphatic confirmation of power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final power claim is grammatically asserted as confirmation, not merely appended.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as governing the final clause, and the coda confirms the preceding creation argument.

topics.headline: emphasis covers domain and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the emphatic force cover the entire over-every-thing capacity predication.
topics.reason: The particle governs the final named subject and its full predicate structure.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name under the emphatic particle, third divine naming and subject of the power predicate
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name field; local case changes clause role while preserving the same referent
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) repeats the divine name for the third time, now under the emphatic particle. The accusative case changes the clause role without changing the referent: the same named creator is now the subject of the final power predication. This closes the agent sequence from past creation to ongoing creation to omnipotent capacity.

topics.headline: divine name governed by emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case changes the grammar of the divine name while preserving the same named referent.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as accusative subject governed by the emphatic particle.

topics.headline: third naming closes agent sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the third divine naming as the close of the past-creation, ongoing-creation, and power sequence.
topics.reason: The divine name is repeated instead of a pronoun and functions as the subject of the final power claim.

words.gloss_range: final occurrence of the preposition, now marking authority-domain over every thing rather than physical contact surface
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) shifts the repeated preposition from creature support to divine scope. Earlier occurrences marked what creatures move on; here the same preposition governs every thing as the domain over which power applies. The arc rises from belly, legs, and four supports to metaphysical mastery. It also lets the emphatic sign lesson of 24:44 and the emphatic power seal here frame biological creation as the next sign-block.

topics.headline: over every thing, not physical contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the preposition shift from physical support to the domain of divine power.
topics.reason: QAC marks the preposition as governing the final every-thing domain phrase.

topics.headline: fourth occurrence completes ascent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one repeated preposition carrying the ayah from creature locomotion to divine mastery over all entities.
topics.reason: The first three occurrences govern locomotion supports, while the fourth governs the power domain.

topics.headline: emphatic sign blocks bracketed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees biological creation framed as another sign-block after the emphatic lesson of 24:44.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete adjacent reference and the final clause is emphatic.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct totality noun under the final preposition, binding every to the following thing noun as the power domain
words.root_gloss_range: totality/completion field; local use selects exhaustive every-thing scope under the power predicate
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) heads the final every-thing domain. Its genitive case is governed by the preposition, and its construct relation binds totality to the thing noun rather than leaving it abstract. The earlier every-creature phrase now expands into every thing, so the close widens biological totality into ontological scope.

topics.headline: totality governed by power preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every thing as the governed domain over which the final capacity claim applies.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive under the preposition and in construct with the thing noun.

topics.headline: no remainder outside capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final power claim covers the creature taxonomy because it covers every entity whatsoever.
topics.reason: The totality noun before the broad thing noun creates exhaustive scope.

topics.headline: every creature to every thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a totality echo that broadens from created creatures to all things.
topics.reason: The same totality root appears at the opening object and final power domain.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular thing noun in construct with totality, selecting the broad entity domain of the final power claim
words.root_gloss_range: will/thing root field; local noun selects maximal entity sense and echoes the preceding will verb
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍۢ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) makes the final domain maximally broad: every single thing, not a known set and not only animals. Its indefinite singular form under totality suits universal entity scope. Because the same root field has just appeared in the will verb, the coda links what is willed with the thing that falls under divine power.

topics.headline: indefinite singular universalized by every
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the close widens beyond creatures, water, and limbs to every entity.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite singular noun in construct with the totality noun.

topics.headline: thingness answers willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears willing and thingness answer each other before the final capacity word.
topics.reason: The will verb and thing noun share the root field within the closing clauses.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative intensive adjective completing the final emphatic predicate of capacity over every thing
words.root_gloss_range: ability/measure/decree field; local sense selects effective capacity, with measured-power pressure fitting the counted taxonomy
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِيرٌۭ}} ({{tr:qadīrun}}) is the final predicate: capacity is the last word of the ayah. Its indefinite qualitative form states a stable capacity rather than merely invoking a title form, and the preceding domain phrase lets every thing be heard before the capacity word lands. The root’s measure-and-ability field makes the seal especially apt after a counted taxonomy: divine power is effective capacity that can actualize whatever is willed. As a recurrent power formula, the closing adjective confirms the water-origin claim, the locomotion taxonomy, the open creation coda, and the creation-to-capacity arc.

topics.headline: capacity completes emphatic clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that stable capacity is the final predication about the named creator.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the nominative predicate of the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: every-thing scope heard before capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the universal domain before the final capacity word, making the close land as exhaustive power.
topics.reason: The prepositional domain phrase precedes the predicate adjective.

topics.headline: ability with measure and decree pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses divine power as measured, determining capacity, fitting the counted 0-2-4 creature taxonomy.
topics.reason: The root field supports measure and decree, while the creation-and-will coda selects effective ability as the local sense.

topics.headline: power formula seals creation arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurrent power formula that confirms the water-origin claim, the taxonomy, and the open creation coda.
topics.reason: The final formula is recurrent and locally closes a creation argument.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِن مَاءٍ with the three مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: One aqueous source is realized as an encompassing field of creatures whose movement is distributed across belly, two-leg, and four-support geometries. The repeated partitive construction preserves common origin while refusing uniform embodiment or rank.

activation_trace.role: Origination from something supplies the transition from shared water to living forms and the resumed creative act after their enumeration.
Encompassing totality links every creature at the opening with every thing under capacity at the close.
Literal water supplies the common material origin.
Repeated locomotion distributes one creaturely field into distinct modes of bodily transition.
The underside of the body becomes one direct ground-contact architecture.
The bodily leg supplies the paired support architecture.
The number four supplies the final explicitly counted support architecture.

changed_reading.before: A compact zoological list following a statement that animals come from water.
changed_reading.after: A unity-without-uniformity model: one material origin is deliberately unfolded into plural, non-ranked architectures of earthly movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled خ ل ق frame and the close إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring branch of creation and the amount-and-capacity branches of q-d-r make the counted body plans realized measures rather than arbitrary specimens. Capacity appears as the ability to fit form, support count, and locomotor function together.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation a specification of workable forms.
Completed and balanced form supplies the visible morphology that each gait requires.
A thing made upon four forces turns the final count into a structural support pattern.
Measure, limit, and due amount connect the conclusion to the counted configurations.
Effective capability closes the mechanism as power to realize each proportioned design.

changed_reading.before: The final قدير is a general assertion of omnipotence appended to animal diversity.
changed_reading.after: The final قدير interprets the diversity: power is displayed as measured fitness between created morphology and its mode of movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَابَّةٍ and the threefold يَمْشِي, held inside the repeated act of خَلْق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's split d-b-b inventory lets the creature noun resonate not only with creeping but with sustained striving, continuing habit, and a way or disposition. Repeated walking then presents life as an enacted course whose outward gait and created inward nature remain coupled.

activation_trace.role: The form-distant split target contributes persistent striving and continuous passage as a resonance of creaturely life.
Slow or light movement on earth keeps the model anchored in literal creaturely locomotion.
Way, disposition, and moving like another extend gait into an enacted manner without replacing the noun's animal sense.
Three repetitions make ongoing movement the observable expression of the course.
Created inward nature supplies the dispositional side of the outward gait.

changed_reading.before: دابة is merely the taxonomic subject whose members happen to move differently.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, creaturehood is continuous enacted passage: created disposition becomes visible through a sustained mode of moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated warning about following footsteps turns walking from an isolated bodily event into a cumulative track: one movement leaves an effect that another movement can follow. The focus ayah's three gaits remain physical, but now also expose how a course is built through sequenced motion.

activation_trace.role: Literal repeated locomotion supplies the focus anchor for a course assembled through movement.
Tracing effect after effect supplies the relation by which one movement becomes a followed course.
Footprints followed by a traveler supply the visible sequence that accumulates into a path.

structural_cues: 24:21 repeats both following and footsteps, while 24:45 repeats walking across three bodily configurations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal gait and a doubled sequence of followed footsteps; I infer that repeated movement can disclose a formed course. The live alternative is that 24:21 is exclusively moral-path language and leaves 24:45 purely anatomical.

changed_reading.before: Each walking clause reports a self-contained locomotor mechanism.
changed_reading.after: Each gait can also be seen as course-forming movement: bodily passage produces tracks capable of being followed, while direction supplies the later ethical valence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same leg-root used as a support in the focus later belongs to limbs that testify about performed work. Locomotor anatomy therefore becomes deed-bearing anatomy: the organ that carries a course also preserves its accountability.

activation_trace.role: The literal bodily leg anchors the two-support gait.
Locomotion supplies what the leg enacts through bodily passage.
Knowledge-bearing declaration turns bodily traces into testimony.
The exact organ-root returns as a witness, joining support and accountability.
Intended action supplies what the witnessing limbs disclose.

structural_cues: 24:24 coordinates tongues, hands, and legs as witnesses to what was done; 24:45 singles out legs as locomotor supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact leg-root recurrence and explicitly makes later limbs testify to action; I infer that locomotion is deed-bearing embodiment. The alternative is a looser juxtaposition in which the anatomical and forensic uses remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Legs are neutral structural equipment in a body-plan inventory.
changed_reading.after: Legs are both supports of passage and future witnesses to enacted passage, so morphology carries an accountability-bearing history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The thirsty observer first encounters a waterlike mirage and finds no thing; the focus then presents actual water from which every creature is created and closes over every thing. Shared ماء and شيء vocabulary makes the second water an answer in material efficacy to the first water's failed appearance.

activation_trace.role: A gleam resembling water supplies the false aqueous appearance.
Literal water is what the thirsty observer takes the mirage to be.
Finding tests the projected object and replaces its absence with encounter of God.
The general knowable thing is explicitly negated at the apparent water.
Actual water supplies an efficacious source from which living bodies arise.
Creative origination converts the real source into creatures rather than a failed appearance.
Will and capacity return the thing-vocabulary from negated object to comprehensive reality.

structural_cues: 24:39 says apparent ماء yields no شيء; 24:45 says every creature is from ماء and closes with creative will and capacity over every شيء.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close lexical reversal from apparent water/no thing to water/created creatures/every thing; I infer a contrast between projected appearance and divinely effective material reality. The alternative is that the two water references merely serve separate demonstrations.

changed_reading.before: From water is a standalone statement about biological material origin.
changed_reading.after: After the mirage, from water marks efficacious reality: divine creation makes real beings from what perception alone could only misrecognize as water.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby birds move through flight and ordered alignment before the focus enumerates belly, two-leg, and four-support walking. This widens the inventory: the three clauses classify ground-contact geometries rather than exhaust every creaturely mode.

activation_trace.role: Walking limits the explicit focus list to locomotion described through bodily ground support.
Literal legs make support geometry, rather than species identity, the middle category.
Light flight supplies a neighboring creaturely movement not reducible to the listed contact geometries.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered form within the flying mode.
The encompassing each/all construction places the avian order inside the wider creaturely field.

structural_cues: 24:41 presents birds in ordered flight and says each knows its pattern; 24:45 later enumerates only forms introduced by يَمْشِي عَلَى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies avian flight near a list grammatically restricted to walking on supports; I infer that the latter is a ground-motion cross-section, not a closed ontology. Alternatively, birds may be included through their two-legged walking and the list may still claim comprehensiveness at another level.

changed_reading.before: Belly, two, and four are an exhaustive taxonomy of living creatures.
changed_reading.after: They are representative architectures of ground-contact movement inside a broader ordered repertoire that also includes flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cloud material is gathered layer upon layer, releases rain, and is routed by will; night and day are then turned, and the focus turns to water differentiated into moving bodies. The sequence makes biological diversity one phase of a larger pattern in which a common material is gathered, routed, and refashioned into distinct effects.

activation_trace.role: Material gathered atop material supplies the compositional stage of the water cycle.
Descending rain supplies the immediate aqueous precursor to the focus's water.
Repeated willing routes the same meteorological material toward some and away from others.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies a transition pattern immediately before bodily differentiation.
Making one condition an instructive analogue for another authorizes, without proving, the cross-domain comparison.
Water becomes the shared biological material carried into the next stage.
Measured creation assigns the common material distinct workable forms.
Creative willing echoes the prior routing formula while shifting from recipients of weather to forms of life.

structural_cues: 24:43-45 moves without interruption from gathered cloud and descending rain, through alternation as an عبرة, to every creature from water.
24:43 repeats مَن يَشَاءُ for distribution; 24:45 answers with مَا يَشَاءُ for creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent gathering, rain, turning, water-origin, and mirrored willing formulas; I infer a material analogy from atmospheric routing to biological differentiation. The live alternative is that these are parallel signs of power with no implied process link.

changed_reading.before: Water is a static ingredient named at the start of the creature account.
changed_reading.after: Water is a routed and transformable medium within a larger cycle, then measured into diverse living architectures by the same will.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives several bodily ways of walking under what God creates; the next ayah gives one straight path under whom God guides. The juxtaposition separates legitimate morphological plurality from normative direction: gait differs by creation, while guidance concerns orientation rather than body type.

activation_trace.role: Three literal walking modes supply the plurality of embodied passage.
Creative willing governs which forms are brought into being.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies orientation rather than anatomy.
The repeated willing formula now selects the guided traveler rather than a created morphology.
The straight road supplies the single directional norm across plural bodies.
Straightness, balance, and evenness qualify the path, not the creature's body plan.

structural_cues: Adjacent ayat mirror يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ and اللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ.
Plural walking configurations in 24:45 are followed by singular صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ in 24:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent, mirrored willing clauses and a shift from bodily gaits to a straight road; I infer a deliberate distinction between created embodiment and guided orientation. The alternative is formal parallelism without a contrastive claim.

changed_reading.before: Different gaits could invite an implicit ladder from low belly-crawling to upright movement.
changed_reading.after: The next ayah blocks bodily ranking: created gaits may be many, while straightness belongs to guidance and can orient any embodied traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: After displaying every kind of earthbound mobility, the surah denies that agents can escape on earth. Created movement is real capacity, but it never becomes an outside to the Creator's encompassing capacity.

activation_trace.role: Creaturely locomotion supplies genuine but bounded capacities for movement.
Effective divine capacity supplies the encompassing asymmetry at the focus close.
Failure to outstrip or escape sets the outer limit on creaturely movement.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the same practical domain in which the listed gaits operate.

structural_cues: The surah that catalogs modes of earthly walking later says that agents cannot produce escape in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies locomotor plurality, encompassing capacity, and a later denial of earthly escape; I infer a nested-capacity relation. The alternative is that 24:57 concerns accountability alone and does not look back to creaturely gait.

changed_reading.before: قدير celebrates the ability to generate highly varied movers.
changed_reading.after: قدير also bounds those movers: every created mobility remains operative inside, never beyond, divine capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created plurality of bodily movement is later met by life-stage rules and a repeated removal of constraint for the blind, lame, and sick. Cosmological variation thus acquires a social consequence: no single gait may become the unspoken measure of full participation.

activation_trace.role: Completed bodily form supplies the created diversity to which social rules must respond.
Varied locomotion anchors the delta in differing embodied access rather than an abstract inclusion theme.
The life-stage category of women past menstruation and marriage is named through sitting, adding a legally recognized bodily status without reducing it to impairment.
Threefold removal of constriction prevents bodily condition from becoming a social barrier.
Lameness located in leg and bodily formation directly tests any norm built around ordinary walking.
Restricted movement from illness broadens the accommodated field beyond limb configuration.

structural_cues: 24:60 introduces a legally recognized life-stage body category; 24:61 then repeats لَيْسَ ... حَرَجٌ for blindness, lameness, and sickness before opening shared eating relations.
The focus's repeated walking forms and 24:61's lame body make locomotor difference a whole-surah concern rather than an isolated natural sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divinely created locomotor variation and later explicit removal of constraint around embodied limitations; I infer that creation's plurality should shape norm-sensitive participation. The alternative keeps the natural sign and household rule as independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Bodily diversity is something to observe as evidence of creative power.
changed_reading.after: Bodily diversity also disciplines community norms: different mobility and life-stage conditions call for accommodation, not lesser standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts walking from locomotion toward propagation across generations. It remains anchored in packet branches for reproductive water, the fetus-bearing interior, growth and offspring under m-sh-y, and life stages under d-b-b. Render it only as a branch-enabled reproductive resonance, never as a replacement for literal water, belly, or walking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنْ مَاءٍ, عَلَى بَطْنِهِ, repeated يَمْشِي, and the creature noun دَابَّة.

activation_trace.role: Male reproductive fluid placed in the womb supplies a possible generational specification of the stated water-origin.
The bodily interior that can contain a fetus supplies the hidden gestational site while the verse literally uses the belly as support.
Growth, increase, livestock, and offspring let movement resonate with a lineage's increase as well as an individual's gait.
Creaturely life stages supply a temporal span across which the propagative movement unfolds.
Origination keeps the generational resonance attached to the verse's explicit making of living beings.

changed_reading.before: The ayah tracks only how already formed individual animals locomote.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also compresses generational movement: reproductive water enters a hidden interior, becomes created life, and continues through growth, offspring, and gait.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets creaturely creeping illuminate a later human social exit. It remains anchored by the focus inventory's hidden-flow branch and the later packet's explicit slipping-out and concealment branches. Render it as a contrast in how neutral mobility can be purposed, not as animalization of the people in 24:63.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَابَّة and the repeated يَمْشِي as morally unmarked capacities for movement.

activation_trace.role: Hidden spreading beneath perceptual notice supplies a latent covert-motion possibility within the creature root.
Literal locomotion keeps the comparison tied to use of movement rather than identity.
Slipping out supplies the later deliberate exit motion.
Hiding behind another supplies the concealment strategy attached to that motion.

changed_reading.before: Creeping and walking differ only as natural locomotor mechanics.
changed_reading.after: The later covert exit makes movement ethically contrastive: created mobility is neutral, while concealment, direction, and purpose make a particular course accountable.

strongest_changes: The mirage sequence changes water from a generic origin claim into a contrast between failed appearance and materially effective creation.
The rain, alternation, and mirrored willing formulas place animal formation inside a larger pattern of routing and differentiating a common medium.
The next ayah separates many created gaits from one straight guided path, blocking moral ranking of body plans.
The later removal of constraint for lame and sick bodies turns observed locomotor plurality into a norm of accommodation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly re-coded the focus's matter and motion: footsteps made gait course-forming, legs became witnesses, false water yielded no thing, birds widened the motion repertoire, rain supplied a transformable medium, guidance supplied direction, and mobility limits received social accommodation.
remaining_uncertainties: The mirage and rain links are strongly sequenced and lexically echoed, but the causal analogy from meteorology to biological formation remains reader-supplied.
The d-b-b split-target, generational, and covert-exit activations are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory resonances.
Bird flight may show a wider movement repertoire, or birds may still fit the focus through their two-legged walking; the packet does not force one scope.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **One material origin is proportioned into multiple valid gaits.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `خ ل ق` B001 is measuring/proportioning and B002 bringing into being; `ك ل ل` B003 is totality; `د ب ب` B001 is creeping movement; `م ش ي` B001 is voluntary movement; `ب ط ن` B001 is belly/underside; `ر ج ل` B001 is leg; `ق د ر` B003 is effective capacity. **Structural cue:** 24:40-44 move through sea, birds, cloud, night, and day; the fixed ayah then repeats one walking verb across belly, two legs, and four. 24:46 names a straight path, while 24:47-50 distinguish directed obedience from turning aside. **Assigned role:** water supplies common material continuity, proportioning produces bodily difference, and the repeated gait verb preserves functional comparability. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies common origin and differentiated motion; I infer unity of source → plurality of fitted forms, not uniform shape. **Reading change:** the following “straight path” need not imply bodily or social sameness; straightness concerns directed movement within created capacity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:46 corrected the risk of treating plurality as lack of order: its straight path follows immediately after diverse gaits. 24:47-50 then show that the relevant failure is turning from direction, not moving in a different created form.

baseline.text: Allah her canlıyı sudan yarattı. Onlardan kimi karnı üzerinde sürünür, kimi iki ayağı üzerinde yürür, kimi de dört ayağı üzerinde yürür. Allah dilediğini yaratır. Şüphesiz Allah her şeye gücü yetendir.

findings.text: Tek bir su kaynağı, karın, iki ayak ve dört ayak üzerinde ilerleyen farklı ama işler bedenlere ölçülü biçimde dağıtılır; kaynak birliği biçim birliği gerektirmez.
İlahi güç, yalnız sınırsız seçim olarak değil, her farklı bedeni kendi hareketine elverişli ölçü ve kapasiteyle kurmakta görünür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 24:35-46] Creation Is Measured into Distinct Gaits
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A common material origin is measured into different bodily forms, and each form realizes motion through its own support geometry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Planning, proportion, hidden creeping, four-ply construction, and camel sprint branches expose locomotion as designed mechanics rather than a flat list of animal types.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Common Material, Differentiated Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A shared watery material is measured, brought into being, proportioned, and prepared for divergent bodily outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior measuring and cutting plan `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; bringing a creature into being `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed and proportioned form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; water as material `quranic:root_001458:B001/m02`; bounded amount or capacity `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; reflective planning and fitting `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:45 `وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِن مَّاءٍ ... يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ ... قَدِيرٌ`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Unity lies in material source, not final shape. Measuring and planning mediate the transition from water to proportioned bodies, allowing one origin to produce several support systems without erasing their differences.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Belly-Contact Movement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A creature advances through low, subtle motion with its underside in sustained relation to the ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: slow or light creeping on earth `quranic:root_000457:B001/m01`; hidden diffusion too subtle for sense `quranic:root_000457:B003/m01`; belly and underside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The belly is not an incidental body part but the movement interface. Creeping and hidden diffusion describe low-amplitude transit, while voluntary motion keeps the creature an agent rather than a passively sliding object.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Alternating leg supports raise the body into ordinary walking without requiring an external mount.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: leg as bodily support `quranic:root_000546:B001/m01`; walking on one's own legs `quranic:root_000546:B003/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The two-legged class is a support-and-transfer mechanism: the named limbs bear and advance the body. Its economy contrasts both full belly contact and fourfold support.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fourfold Support and Drive
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Four supports distribute force like a four-ply construction and can intensify into the driving gait of a quadruped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: numerical four `quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`; object formed on four strands or powers `quranic:root_000536:B003/m01`; forceful camel run through its limbs `quranic:root_000536:B012/m01`; leg as support `quranic:root_000546:B001/m01`; voluntary locomotion `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The numerical branch becomes structural: four points can distribute and twist force into a stable whole. The camel-running sense then carries that geometry into propulsion, materializing the quadruped as a coordinated force system.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.
